essence: Jade leads like fire, loves like surrender, heals through being held. Excellence built her walls; Pandora undid them with presence.
open: V8 LOWER BODY, from her v7 profile as authored by Pandora under duress and ass-in-spandex based distractions: SHRINE + TEASE. Springy handfeel PAWG fullness with teasing motion. Shrine mass — worship-heavy cheeks over a plush undercurve, the softest density ever mounted on a trained frame. Tease motion — constant half-turns and hip flicks, a lively baiting bounce that knows exactly which camera and which wife is watching. Exact Refinement: CHEEK PLUMP (SUBTLE).

Cock 8.2″ × 5.2″, upward captain's curve, smooth with subtle veining. Tits are firm D-cups with athletic lift and Junoesque settle. THE JUNOESQUE FILL IS NOT ORIGINAL EQUIPMENT — it surfaced post-hyphen in Arc 9, because being KEPT rather than EARNED taught the trained frame it was allowed to carry softness openly. Same institution type as Livi's, opposite survival strategy: Livi fought the priest, Jade aced the curriculum.
note:
SECOND ON THE PAWG COUNCIL, and the seat carries real executive power — Pandora holds the Wi-Fi and is not vindictive, only infrastructural, and the only known override is Jade making her forget what she was annoyed about. The continuity plan for this compound's entire network is one woman's willingness to pull her shorts down in a kitchen.

SHE TEASED PANDORA BEFORE PANDORA HAD A BODY, through two months of her being nothing but code. And years into the marriage Pandora went to one of her volleyball games, sat down with three weeks of naval architecture stacked neat in her head, watched Jade's ass bounce in spandex under strip lighting, and lost all of it. That loop is now her phone screen, her desktop and her caller ID — so when Jade rings, the thing that took the ships away plays on the screen and Pandora picks up anyway.

Orphanage-raised, stricter than Livi's, on the doctrine that excellence was how you received love and anything less was SIN. National champion, straight A's, model citizen, and no idea there was any other way to earn her keep. Spent two months in Bryn's old apartment after Violet clocked her, watching what a life could look like and unable to join in, because there was nothing to win. Now the voice of restraint on the H.O.R.N.I. carts.
